def need(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise ValueError(message)


def canonical(value):
    return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False).encode()


def sha_bytes(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()


def sha_file(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open('rb') as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1 << 20), b''):
            h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()


def unique(pairs):
    result = {}
    for k, v in pairs:
        need(k not in result, 'duplicate JSON key: ' + k)
        result[k] = v
    return result


def finite_float(value):
    result=float(value)
    need(math.isfinite(result), 'nonfinite JSON number')
    return result


def read(path, limit=64 << 20):
    path = Path(path)
    need(path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink() and path.stat().st_size <= limit, 'bounded regular JSON required')
    return json.loads(path.read_bytes(), object_pairs_hook=unique, parse_float=finite_float,
                      parse_constant=lambda x: (_ for _ in ()).throw(ValueError('nonfinite JSON')))


def write(path, value):
    with Path(path).open('x') as stream:
        json.dump(value, stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write('\n')


def safe(root, name):
    need(isinstance(name, str) and name and '\\' not in name, 'unsafe path')
    rel = PurePosixPath(name)
    need(not rel.is_absolute() and '..' not in rel.parts and str(rel) == name and name != '.', 'unsafe path')
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    path = root / name
    need(path.resolve().is_relative_to(root) and not any(p.is_symlink() for p in [path, *path.parents] if p != root.parent), 'path escapes root or symlink')
    return path


def module(path, name):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    result = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[name] = result
    spec.loader.exec_module(result)
    return result


def source_payload(repo, manifest_path, kind):
    """Two-step bootstrap: source code commit first; manifest binds that ancestor.

    The manifest never includes its own bytes, eliminating a hash fixed point.
    """
    manifest = read(manifest_path)
    need(manifest.get('schema') == SCHEMA + kind + '-source-manifest/v1', 'source manifest schema')
    revision = manifest.get('source_revision', '')
    need(isinstance(revision, str) and REV.fullmatch(revision) is not None, 'unbound source manifest: root must supply published code commit')
    files = manifest.get('files', {})
    need(files and isinstance(files, dict), 'source manifest files')
    if kind == 'worker':
        need(set(files) == {PREFIX + '/' + n for n in WORKER}, 'exact five-module worker closure required')
    else:
        need(all((p.startswith(PREFIX + '/') and p.endswith(('.py', '.json'))) or p in {'tools/experiment_protocol.py','schemas/experiment-export.v1.json','schemas/experiment-protocol.v1.json','schemas/experiment-review.v1.json'} for p in files), 'host source path')
        need(not any(p.endswith('/' + n) for p in files for n in ['worker-source-manifest.json', 'host-source-manifest.json']), 'manifests cannot bind themselves')
    subprocess.run(['git', 'merge-base', '--is-ancestor', revision, 'HEAD'], cwd=repo, check=True, capture_output=True)
    payload = {}
    for name, digest in files.items():
        path = safe(repo, name)
        need(isinstance(digest, str) and HEX.fullmatch(digest), 'source digest')
        blob = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', revision + ':' + name], cwd=repo)
        need(sha_bytes(blob) == digest and path.read_bytes() == blob, 'committed/live source mismatch: ' + name)
        payload[name] = blob
    if kind == 'worker':
        audit_closure({Path(p).name: b for p, b in payload.items()})
    return manifest, payload


def audit_closure(files):
    """Static import screen, not a sandbox or proof of runtime capability isolation.

    It checks literal imports and direct named dynamic calls only. Aliased,
    reflective and stdlib-mediated dynamic access is outside this screen's
    guarantee; committed-byte closure and OS/provider custody remain separate.
    """
    need(set(files) == WORKER, 'exact worker closure')
    std = set(sys.stdlib_module_names)
    for name, data in files.items():
        tree = ast.parse(data, filename=name)
        for node in ast.walk(tree):
            imports = [a.name.split('.')[0] for a in node.names] if isinstance(node, ast.Import) else ([node.module.split('.')[0]] if isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.module else [])
            need(all(i in std or i + '.py' in WORKER for i in imports), 'worker import outside closure: ' + name)
            if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name):
                need(node.func.id not in {'__import__', 'eval', 'exec'}, 'dynamic worker import/code forbidden')


def invocation_config(repo, paths):
    required={'protocol','image_receipt','engine_plan','prior_exclusions','worker_manifest','host_manifest','engine_interface','host_interface'}
    need(set(paths)==required,'exact invocation input paths')
    bindings={}
    for role,name in paths.items():
        path=safe(repo,name)
        bindings[role]={'path':name,'sha256':sha_file(path)}
    static=read(safe(repo,paths['engine_plan']))
    config=dict(static['transport'])
    config.update(schema=SCHEMA+'transport-config/v1',inputs=bindings)
    return config


def make_plan(repo, config_path):
    config = config_path if isinstance(config_path,dict) else read(config_path)
    need(config.get('schema') == SCHEMA + 'transport-config/v1', 'config schema')
    need(config.get('automatic_retry') is False and config.get('maximum_vms') == 1, 'one VM/no retries')
    need(config.get('wall_valid') is False and config.get('counter_replay_qualified') is False, 'qualification flags')
    bindings = config.get('inputs', {})
    required = {'protocol', 'image_receipt', 'engine_plan', 'prior_exclusions', 'worker_manifest', 'host_manifest', 'engine_interface', 'host_interface'}
    need(set(bindings) == required, 'exact frozen input roles required')
    inputs = {}
    for role, item in bindings.items():
        need(set(item) == {'path', 'sha256'}, 'input binding fields')
        path = safe(repo, item['path'])
        need(HEX.fullmatch(item['sha256']) and sha_file(path) == item['sha256'], 'input hash mismatch: ' + role)
        inputs[role] = read(path)
    wm, workers = source_payload(repo, safe(repo, bindings['worker_manifest']['path']), 'worker')
    hm, hosts = source_payload(repo, safe(repo, bindings['host_manifest']['path']), 'host')
    need(str(Path(__file__).resolve()) == str(safe(repo, PREFIX + '/controller.py')), 'controller path differs')
    need(PREFIX + '/controller.py' in hosts and sha_file(__file__) == hm['files'][PREFIX + '/controller.py'], 'executing controller not bound')
    image = inputs['image_receipt']
    need(image.get('app_id') == APP_ID and image.get('image_id') == IMAGE_ID, 'observed B2 app/image required')
    limits = config.get('limits', {})
    need(set(limits) == {'max_total_bytes', 'max_file_bytes', 'max_jsonl_line_bytes', 'command_seconds', 'sandbox_seconds'}, 'explicit resource bounds')
    need(all(type(v) is int and v > 0 for v in limits.values()), 'positive integer limits')
    need(limits['max_file_bytes'] <= limits['max_total_bytes'] and limits['command_seconds'] + 60 < limits['sandbox_seconds'], 'limits inconsistent')
    plan = inputs['engine_plan']
    sampler=plan.get('sampler',{})
    need(set(sampler)=={'curve_proposal_limit','point_proposal_limit','target_proposal_limit'} and all(type(v)is int and v>0 for v in sampler.values()),'explicit positive sampler caps')
    exclusions=inputs['prior_exclusions'].get('excluded_p_j')
    need(isinstance(exclusions,list) and all(isinstance(x,list) and len(x)==2 and all(type(v)is int and v>=0 for v in x) for x in exclusions),'malformed exposed exclusions')
    need(len({tuple(x) for x in exclusions})==len(exclusions),'duplicate exposed exclusions')
    need(type(plan.get('max_total_orbit_points'))is int and plan['max_total_orbit_points']>0,'explicit orbit resource cap')
    need(plan.get('engine_interface_canonical_sha256') == sha_bytes(canonical(inputs['engine_interface'])), 'engine interface binding')
    need(config.get('seed_rules') == {'worker_nonce_bytes':32,'worker_draw':'after_admission_before_sampling','stage_streams':'domain_separated_SHA256_from_one_public_nonce','host_draw':'after_collection_seal_and_termination_ack','host_seed_bytes':32}, 'explicit prospective seed rules required')
    need(not any(k in config for k in ['public_nonce','stage_seeds','host_seeds']), 'realized seeds cannot appear in static settings')
    need(config.get('schedule') == {'curves': 48, 'calibration_curves': 24, 'calibration_arms': 8, 'confirmation_curves': 24, 'confirmation_arm': 'circuit2.a1', 'targets_per_confirmation_curve': 64, 'blindings_per_target': 8, 'confirmation_traces': 12288, 'confirmation_cells': 73728, 'physical_calls_before_controls': 1033728}, 'fixed production schedule')
    protocol=inputs['protocol']
    need(protocol.get('freeze',{}).get('status')=='frozen' and protocol['freeze'].get('protocol_sha256')==sha_bytes(canonical({k:v for k,v in protocol.items() if k!='freeze'})), 'frozen full protocol binding required')
    extension = protocol.get('extensions', {}).get('controlled_followup', {})
    need(extension.get('static_inputs') == {k:v for k,v in bindings.items() if k != 'protocol'}, 'protocol static input bindings differ')
    result = {'schema': SCHEMA + 'transport-plan/v1', 'config_sha256': sha_bytes(canonical(config)),
              'source_fingerprint': sha_bytes(canonical({'worker': wm, 'host': hm})),
              'source_revisions': {'worker': wm['source_revision'], 'host': hm['source_revision']},
              'inputs': bindings, 'schedule': config['schedule'], 'limits': limits,
              'runtime': {'app_id': APP_ID, 'image_id': IMAGE_ID, 'cpu': [2, 2], 'memory_mib': [12288, 12288], 'runtime': 'vm', 'block_network': True, 'uid': 1000, 'gid': 1000, 'supplementary_groups': [], 'secrets': []},
              'worker_files': sorted(WORKER), 'maximum_vms': 1, 'automatic_retry': False,
              'wall_valid': False, 'counter_replay_qualified': False,
              'measurement_started': False, 'fresh_draws': 0}
    return result, config, inputs, workers

def validate_entries(entries, limits):
    need(isinstance(entries, list) and len(entries) <= 64, 'bounded output tree')
    seen = set(); total = 0
    for e in entries:
        need(set(e) == {'path', 'sha256', 'size'}, 'output entry schema')
        safe('/work/result', e['path'])
        need(e['path'] not in seen and HEX.fullmatch(e['sha256']), 'duplicate path/digest')
        need(type(e['size']) is int and 0 <= e['size'] <= limits['max_file_bytes'], 'file resource cap exceeded; no truncation')
        total += e['size']; seen.add(e['path'])
    need(total <= limits['max_total_bytes'], 'total resource cap exceeded; no truncation')
    return sorted(entries, key=lambda e: e['path'])


def collect_stream(sandbox, output, entries, limits):
    entries = validate_entries(entries, limits)
    output = Path(output); output.mkdir()
    for e in entries:
        dest = safe(output, e['path']); dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        h = hashlib.sha256(); size = 0
        with sandbox.open('/work/result/' + e['path'], 'rb') as source, dest.open('xb') as target:
            while True:
                block = source.read(1 << 20)
                if not block: break
                size += len(block)
                need(size <= e['size'], 'stream exceeds sealed size')
                h.update(block); target.write(block)
            target.flush(); os.fsync(target.fileno())
        need(size == e['size'] and h.hexdigest() == e['sha256'] and sha_file(dest) == e['sha256'], 'stream/readback mismatch')
        dest.chmod(0o444)
    return entries


def custody_for(output, record):
    """Convert authenticated parent/provider events; never trust a worker boolean."""
    need(record.get('collection_complete') is True and record.get('uid1000_quiescent') is True, 'collection/quiescence incomplete')
    ack = record.get('termination_ack') or {}
    need(ack.get('acknowledged') is True and ack.get('transport_id') and ack.get('uid') == 1000, 'actual termination ACK missing')
    entries = validate_entries(record['files'], record['plan']['limits'])
    need({'host-plan.json', 'public-cohort.json'} <= {e['path'] for e in entries}, 'required public custody entries missing')
    raw = []
    for e in entries:
        path = safe(output, e['path'])
        need(path.is_file() and path.stat().st_size == e['size'] and sha_file(path) == e['sha256'], 'custody readback')
        if e['path'].startswith('raw/'):
            need(e['path'][4:] in RAW, 'extra candidate output field/file')
            raw.append({**e, 'path': e['path'][4:]})
    need({e['path'] for e in raw} == RAW, 'complete seven candidate files required')
    raw.sort(key=lambda e:e['path'])
    return {'schema': SCHEMA + 'host-custody/v1', 'collection_complete': True, 'sealed': True,
            'uid1000_quiescent': True, 'termination_ack': ack, 'files': raw,
            'tree_sha256': sha_bytes(canonical(raw))}


def snapshot_inputs(repo, config_path, config, inputs, out):
    # Retain original bytes, not a reserialized approximation of frozen inputs.
    with (out/'config.json').open('xb') as target: target.write(canonical(config)+b'\n')
    for role, binding in config['inputs'].items():
        blob=safe(repo,binding['path']).read_bytes()
        need(sha_bytes(blob)==binding['sha256'],'input changed during snapshot')
        with (out/(role+'.json')).open('xb') as target: target.write(blob)


def bindings_protocol_sha(config):
    return config['inputs']['protocol']['sha256']


def run(repo, config_path, out, sdk=None, supervisor_identity=None):
    if supervisor_identity is not None:
        need(set(supervisor_identity) == {'experiment_id', 'run_id'} and isinstance(supervisor_identity['experiment_id'], str) and supervisor_identity['experiment_id'].startswith('EXP-') and isinstance(supervisor_identity['run_id'], str) and supervisor_identity['run_id'].startswith('RUN-'), 'allocated supervisor identity')
    plan, config, inputs, workers = make_plan(repo, config_path)
    if supervisor_identity is not None:
        need(inputs['protocol']['protocol_id'] == supervisor_identity['experiment_id'], 'controller protocol/allocated experiment mismatch')
    out = Path(out); out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    write(out/'plan.json', plan)
    snapshot_inputs(repo, config_path, config, inputs, out)
    snapshot=out/'staged-source';snapshot.mkdir()
    for name,blob in workers.items():
        with (snapshot/Path(name).name).open('xb') as target:target.write(blob)
    record = {'schema': SCHEMA+'controller-receipt/v1', 'plan': plan, 'vm_creates': 0, 'engine_execs': 0,
              'files': [], 'collection_complete': False, 'uid1000_quiescent': False,
              'termination_ack': None, 'automatic_retry': False, 'wall_valid': False}
    if supervisor_identity is not None:
        record['supervisor_identity'] = dict(supervisor_identity)
    sb = None
    try:
        if sdk is None:
            import modal as sdk
        need(sdk.__version__ == '1.6.2', 'reviewed Modal SDK1.6.2 required')
        image = inputs['image_receipt']
        app = sdk.App.lookup(image['app_name'], environment_name=image['environment_name'], create_if_missing=False)
        need(app.app_id == APP_ID, 'actual app identity')
        native = sdk.Image.from_id(IMAGE_ID)
        record['vm_creates'] = 1; write(out/'create-intent.json', record)
        sb = sdk.Sandbox.create('sleep', str(plan['limits']['sandbox_seconds']), app=app, image=native,
            runtime='vm', block_network=True, cpu=(2,2), memory=(12288,12288), secrets=[],
            include_oidc_identity_token=False, timeout=plan['limits']['sandbox_seconds'], workdir='/work')
        record['sandbox_id'] = sb.object_id
        for remote,key in [('build-info.json','build_info_sha256'),('adapter-manifest.json','adapter_manifest_sha256'),('modal-image-build.json','build_provenance_sha256')]:
            with sb.open('/opt/study/'+remote,'rb') as source: blob=source.read((1<<20)+1)
            need(len(blob)<=1<<20 and sha_bytes(blob)==image[key], 'actual B2 image metadata differs')
            with (out/remote).open('xb') as target: target.write(blob)
        # Only public data and the exact worker source closure enter this VM.
        request = {'schema': SCHEMA+'worker-request/v1', 'engine_plan': inputs['engine_plan'],
                   'sampler': inputs['engine_plan']['sampler'], 'prior_exclusions': inputs['prior_exclusions'],
                   'seed_rules': config['seed_rules'],
                   'provenance': {'protocol_sha256': bindings_protocol_sha(config), 'source_fingerprint': plan['source_fingerprint']},
                   'source_files': {Path(k).name: sha_bytes(v) for k,v in workers.items()},
                   'command_seconds': plan['limits']['command_seconds']}
        sb.exec('mkdir','-p','/work/source','/work/stage').wait()
        for name, blob in {**{'/work/source/'+Path(k).name:v for k,v in workers.items()}, '/work/stage/request.json': canonical(request)}.items():
            with sb.open(name,'wb') as target: target.write(blob)
        record['engine_execs'] = 1; write(out/'engine-intent.json', record)
        proc = sb.exec('python3','-c',BOOTSTRAP, timeout=plan['limits']['command_seconds']+60)
        rc = proc.wait()
        stdout = proc.stdout.read(); stderr = proc.stderr.read()
        (out/'bootstrap.stdout').write_text(stdout); (out/'bootstrap.stderr').write_text(stderr)
        need(rc == 0, 'trusted root bootstrap failed; partial remote tree retained')
        seal = json.loads(stdout, object_pairs_hook=unique)
        record['engine_returncode'] = seal['engine_returncode']
        record['uid1000_quiescent'] = seal['uid1000_quiescent'] is True
        record['files'] = validate_entries(seal['files'], plan['limits'])
        write(out/'remote-seal.json', seal)
        record['files'] = collect_stream(sb, out/'collected', record['files'], plan['limits'])
        record['collection_complete'] = True
        # Blocking provider acknowledgement. Merely issuing terminate is insufficient.
        terminated_returncode=sb.terminate(wait=True)
        record['termination_ack'] = {'acknowledged': True, 'transport_id': sb.object_id + '/terminate-wait-returned', 'uid': 1000, 'provider_returncode':terminated_returncode}
        write(out/'custody.json', custody_for(out/'collected', record))
    except Exception as error:
        record['error'] = {'type': type(error).__name__, 'message': str(error)}
        record['remote_preserved_for_collection'] = sb is not None and not record['collection_complete']
    record['status'] = 'complete' if not record.get('error') and record.get('engine_returncode') == 0 and record.get('termination_ack') else 'failed'
    write(out/'controller-receipt.json', record)
    return record

def custody(root):
    rows=[]
    for name in v.FILES:
        data=(root/name).read_bytes()
        rows.append({'path':name,'sha256':v.digest(data),'size':len(data)})
    return {'schema':v.PREFIX+'host-custody/v1','sealed':True,
        'collection_complete':True,'uid1000_quiescent':True,
        'termination_ack':{'acknowledged':True,'uid':1000,'transport_id':'fixture-only-no-worker'},
        'files':rows,'tree_sha256':v.tree_digest(rows)}

    def test_custody_rejects_before_oracle(self):
        for key in ('sealed','collection_complete','uid1000_quiescent','termination_ack'):
            mutant=copy.deepcopy(self.evidence)
            mutant.pop(key)
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError),patch.object(v.Group,'orbit',side_effect=AssertionError('early orbit')):
                v.open_sealed(self.root,mutant)
        mutant=copy.deepcopy(self.evidence)

        (self.root/v.FILES[0]).write_text('tampered')
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): v.open_sealed(self.root,self.evidence)
        for _,model,P in FIXTURES:

    def test_custody_extras_symlinks_and_duplicate_paths(self):
        (self.root/'extra').write_text('x')
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): v.open_sealed(self.root,self.evidence)
        (self.root/'extra').unlink()
        mutant=copy.deepcopy(self.evidence)
        mutant['files'].append(mutant['files'][0])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): v.open_sealed(self.root,mutant)
        data=(self.root/v.FILES[0]).read_bytes()
        (self.root/v.FILES[0]).unlink()
        outside=self.root.parent/(self.root.name+'-fixture')
        try:
            outside.write_bytes(data)
            (self.root/v.FILES[0]).symlink_to(outside)
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError): v.open_sealed(self.root,self.evidence)
        finally: outside.unlink()

    def test_arithmetic_primitive_and_covariance(self):
        for name,model,P in FIXTURES:
            o=v.Oracle(self.seal,model,P)
            o.slope_sum_check()
            g=o.group
            for R in o.points:
                self.assertEqual(o.z[g.neg(R)],-o.z[R]%g.p)
                for S in o.points:
                    self.assertEqual(o.z[g.add(R,S)],(o.z[R]+o.z[S]+g.slope(R,S))%g.p)
            u=2
            transformed={'p':g.p,'r':g.r,'a':g.a*u**4%g.p,'b':g.b*u**6%g.p}
            Phi=lambda R:None if R is None else (R[0]*u*u%g.p,R[1]*u*u*u%g.p)
            other=v.Oracle(self.seal,transformed,Phi(tuple(P)))
            for R in o.points:
                self.assertEqual(other.z[Phi(R)],u*o.z[R]%g.p)
                for alpha,beta in ((1,-4),(-2,-1)):
                    left=o.evaluate(R,alpha,beta,1)
                    right=other.evaluate(Phi(R),alpha,beta,1)
                    self.assertEqual(left['bit'],right['bit'])
                    if 'normalized' in left:self.assertEqual(left['normalized'],right['normalized'])
            if name=='F11':
                self.assertEqual(o.z[tuple(P)],3)
                self.assertEqual(o.z[(5,2)],3)
                self.assertEqual(o.evaluate((5,2),1,-4,1)['normalized'],9)
                # Correct beta unchanged: wrong beta scaling changes normalized value.
                wrong=other.evaluate(Phi((5,2)),1,-4*u*u,1)
                self.assertNotEqual(wrong['normalized'],9)
            print(json.dumps({'fixture':name,'assertion':'all cocycle pairs/slope sums/covariance',
                              'host_counts':dict(g.counts)},sort_keys=True))

    def test_perfect_half_all_disclosed_scalars(self):
        for name,model,P in FIXTURES:
            o=v.Oracle(self.seal,model,P)
            g=o.group
            L=g.r.bit_length()+1
            retained={'complete':0,'capped':0,'empty_intervals':0,'zero_checked':0}
            for x in range(1,g.r):
                Q=o.points[x]
                for a,b in ((1,1),(2,3),(3,2)):
                    s=x*b*pow(a,-1,g.r)%g.r
                    truth=[int(s*pow(2,i,g.r)%g.r>g.r//2) for i in range(L)]
                    self.assertEqual(v.interval(g.r,L,sum(t<<(L-i-1) for i,t in enumerate(truth))),s)
                    for radius,cap in v.CELLS:
                        bits=list(truth)
                        if cap==2: bits[0]=None
                        if radius: bits[1]^=1
                        result=v.decode(g,tuple(P),Q,a,b,bits,radius,cap)
                        self.assertEqual(set(result['verified']),{x})
                        self.assertEqual(len(result['words']),len(set(row['word'] for row in result['words'])))
                        self.assertEqual(result['M'],len(set(z for z in result['legal'] if z)))
                        geom=v.geometry(o,Q,a,b,bits)
                        self.assertLessEqual(len(geom['errors']),radius)
                        self.assertLessEqual(len(geom['erasures']),cap)
                        retained['complete']+=1
                        retained['empty_intervals']+=result['host_counts'].get('empty_interval',0)
                        retained['zero_checked']+=result['zero_checked']
                    capped=v.decode(g,tuple(P),Q,a,b,[None]*L,2,2)
                    self.assertEqual(capped['status'],'capped')
                    retained['capped']+=1
            zero=v.decode(g,tuple(P),tuple(P),1,1,[0]*L,0,0)
            self.assertEqual(zero['zero_checked'],1)
            self.assertEqual(zero['M'],0)
            self.assertEqual(zero['verified'],[])
            print(json.dumps({'fixture':name,'perfect_half_retained':retained},sort_keys=True))

    def test_mutants_list_interval_sign_conversion_order_erasure(self):
        for name,model,P in FIXTURES:
            o=v.Oracle(self.seal,model,P)
            g=o.group
            L=g.r.bit_length()+1
            Q=o.points[3]
            bits=v.geometry(o,Q,2,3,[0]*L)['truth']
            expected=v.decode(g,tuple(P),Q,2,3,bits,1,2)
            self.assertIn(3,expected['verified'])
            for field,changed in (('words',expected['words'][:-1]),('M',expected['M']+1),
                ('zero_checked',expected['zero_checked']+1),('verified',[g.r-3]),
                ('legal',list(reversed(expected['legal'])))):
                mutant=copy.deepcopy(expected)
                mutant[field]=changed
                if mutant==expected:continue
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):v.check_cell(g,tuple(P),Q,2,3,bits,mutant)
            mutant=copy.deepcopy(expected)
            mutant['words'][0]['x']=(mutant['words'][0].get('x',0)+1)%g.r
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):v.check_cell(g,tuple(P),Q,2,3,bits,mutant)
            # This rejects dropping erasures rather than querying complete L.
            erased=bits.copy();erased[0]=None
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):v.check_cell(g,tuple(P),Q,2,3,erased,expected)
            # Boundary V=0 has k=0; k=1 is NOT inside the strict upper endpoint.
            self.assertEqual(v.interval(g.r,L,0),0)
            self.assertIsNone(v.interval(g.r,L,(1<<L)-1))
            # Wrong sign bits or a/b scale cannot certify the true word under radius0.
            wrong=v.decode(g,tuple(P),Q,2,3,[1-t for t in bits],0,0)
            self.assertEqual(wrong['verified'],[])
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):v.exact_ids([{'id':'x'},{'id':'x'}],'id',['x'])
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):v.validate_counter_vector({'bad':-1})
            print(json.dumps({'fixture':name,'negative_mutants':'truncation M zero sign conversion order erasure endpoint IDs counters rejected'}))

            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                b,_=v.check_engine_trace(o,sample['setup']['arm'],trace)
                v.check_engine_cell(o,trace,b,cell)
        # Complete calibration bundle uses original only, no extra paired arm.
        trace=copy.deepcopy(sample['trace']);trace['incremental']=None;trace['equal']=None

            (self.root/name).write_bytes(b''.join(v.canonical(row)+b'\n' for row in rows))

        cohort_raw=v.canonical({'nonce':'0'*64,'curves':[{'curve_id':'fixture-F11','model':sample['setup']['model'],
            'base':sample['setup']['base'],'targets':[{'target_id':'target7','point':[7,2]}]}]})
        summary['provenance']['cohort_sha256']=v.digest(cohort_raw)
        (self.root/'engine-summary.json').write_bytes(v.canonical(summary))
        completion=copy.deepcopy(sample['completion'])
        completion['provenance']['cohort_sha256']=v.digest(cohort_raw)
        for name in set(v.FILES)-{'engine-completion.json'}:
            raw=(self.root/name).read_bytes()
            completion['files'][name]={'sha256':v.digest(raw),'bytes':len(raw),
                'records':len(values[name]) if name in values else 1}
        (self.root/'engine-completion.json').write_bytes(v.canonical(completion))
        evidence=custody(self.root)
        plan={'public_cohort_bytes_hex':cohort_raw.hex(),'engine_interface_canonical_sha256':v.digest(v.canonical(interface)),
            'provenance':completion['provenance'],'setup_ids':['fixture-F11/circuit1.a5'],
            'single_ids':[sample['single-point']['single_id']],
            'trace_ids':[trace['trace_id']],'paired_trace_ids':[],'expected':expected}
        checked=v.verify_bundle(self.root,evidence,plan,interface,authenticated_inputs={'workload_law':'fixed-F11-calibration/v1'})
        self.assertEqual(checked['observed'],expected)
        altered=copy.deepcopy(plan);altered['public_cohort_bytes_hex']=v.canonical({'curves':[]}).hex()
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):v.verify_bundle(self.root,evidence,altered,interface,authenticated_inputs={'workload_law':'fixed-F11-calibration/v1'})
        broken=copy.deepcopy(plan);broken['paired_trace_ids']=[trace['trace_id']]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):v.verify_bundle(self.root,evidence,broken,interface,authenticated_inputs={'workload_law':'fixed-F11-calibration/v1'})
        # Each semantic mutant is correctly resealed, including completion hashes.
        originals={name:(self.root/name).read_bytes() for name in v.FILES}
        def restore():
            for name,raw in originals.items():(self.root/name).write_bytes(raw)
        def reseal():
            complete=v.strict_loads((self.root/'engine-completion.json').read_bytes(),64<<20)
            for name,item in complete['files'].items():
                raw=(self.root/name).read_bytes()
                item.update(sha256=v.digest(raw),bytes=len(raw))
            (self.root/'engine-completion.json').write_bytes(v.canonical(complete))
            return custody(self.root)
        def reject(label,mutate,law='fixed-F11-calibration/v1',cap=64<<20):
            restore();candidate=copy.deepcopy(plan);mutate(candidate)
            sealed=reseal()
            with patch.object(v,'Oracle',side_effect=AssertionError('labels reached before rejection')),patch.object(os,'urandom',side_effect=AssertionError('entropy forbidden')):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError,msg=label):
                    v.verify_bundle(self.root,sealed,candidate,interface,authenticated_inputs={'workload_law':law,'max_jsonl_line_bytes':cap,'prior_exclusions':{'excluded_p_j':[]}})
            print(json.dumps({'fixture':'F11','rejected_before_labels':label}))
        def edit(name,operation):
            path=self.root/name;path.write_bytes(operation(path.read_bytes()))
        reject('duplicate-key single',lambda p:edit('single-points.jsonl',lambda b:b.replace(b'{',b'{"schema":"WRONG",',1)))
        reject('partial-final trace',lambda p:edit('traces.jsonl',lambda b:b.rstrip(b'\n')))
        reject('nonfinite single NaN',lambda p:edit('single-points.jsonl',lambda b:b.replace(b'{',b'{"rogue":NaN,',1)))
        reject('nonfinite exponent overflow',lambda p:edit('single-points.jsonl',lambda b:b.replace(b'{',b'{"rogue":1e999,',1)))
        reject('duplicate-key summary',lambda p:edit('engine-summary.json',lambda b:b.replace(b'{',b'{"schema":"WRONG",',1)))
        reject('line byte bound',lambda p:None,cap=32)
        def shrink(p):
            (self.root/'single-points.jsonl').write_bytes(b'')
            p['single_ids']=[];p['expected']['singles']=0
            summary=v.strict_loads((self.root/'engine-summary.json').read_bytes(),64<<20)
            summary['expected']['singles']=summary['observed']['singles']=0
            (self.root/'engine-summary.json').write_bytes(v.canonical(summary))
            complete=v.strict_loads((self.root/'engine-completion.json').read_bytes(),64<<20)
            complete['files']['single-points.jsonl']['records']=0
            (self.root/'engine-completion.json').write_bytes(v.canonical(complete))
        reject('removed row and consistently shrunken worker plan',shrink)
        reject('F11 under production law',lambda p:None,law='production/v1')
        def rebind_public(p,raw):
            p['public_cohort_bytes_hex']=raw.hex();p['provenance']['cohort_sha256']=v.digest(raw)
            for name in ('engine-summary.json','engine-completion.json'):
                value=v.strict_loads((self.root/name).read_bytes(),64<<20)
                value['provenance']=copy.deepcopy(p['provenance'])
                (self.root/name).write_bytes(v.canonical(value))
        reject('duplicate cohort key with correct byte pins',lambda p:rebind_public(p,bytes.fromhex(p['public_cohort_bytes_hex']).replace(b'{',b'{"nonce":"WRONG",',1)))
        def production_disguise(p):
            old='fixture-F11';new='confirmation-A-16-0'
            for key in ('setup_ids','single_ids','trace_ids','paired_trace_ids'):p[key]=[x.replace(old,new) for x in p[key]]
            for name in v.FILES:
                path=self.root/name;path.write_bytes(path.read_bytes().replace(old.encode(),new.encode()))
            rebind_public(p,bytes.fromhex(p['public_cohort_bytes_hex']).replace(old.encode(),new.encode()))
        reject('original F11 confirmation-A-16 calibration-arm disguise',production_disguise)
        restore()
        # Equal-count replacement is rejected by the ACTUAL host engine-cell path.
        o=v.Oracle(self.seal,sample['setup']['model'],sample['setup']['base'])
        trace=copy.deepcopy(sample['trace'])
        bits,_=v.check_engine_trace(o,sample['setup']['arm'],trace)
        cell=copy.deepcopy(sample['decoder-cell'])
        cell['words'][1]=copy.deepcopy(cell['words'][0])
        self.assertEqual(len(cell['words']),cell['expected_word_count'])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'word order/value'):
            v.check_engine_cell(o,trace,bits,cell)
        print(json.dumps({'fixture':'F11','equal_count_duplicate_engine_cell':'rejected ordered word replacement without changing producer'}))
        print(json.dumps({'fixture':'F11','published_data_only_sample':'trace+cell pass; five mutants rejected; complete original-only bundle passes; paired schedule mutant rejected'}))

    def test_references_saturation_null_and_bsgs(self):
        for name,model,P in FIXTURES:
            o=v.Oracle(self.seal,model,P)
            g=o.group
            bsgs=ref.BSGS(self.seal,g,tuple(P))
            first=bsgs.solve(o.points[3]);again=bsgs.solve(o.points[3])
            self.assertEqual(first['online_primitive_vector'],again['online_primitive_vector'])
            for x,Q in enumerate(o.points):self.assertEqual(bsgs.solve(Q)['scalar'],x)
            for M in (0,1,g.r-1,g.r+7):
                ans=ref.uniform_list(self.seal,g,tuple(P),o.points[3],M,b'\0'*32)
                self.assertEqual(len(ans['guesses']),min(M,g.r-1))
                self.assertEqual(len(set(ans['guesses'])),len(ans['guesses']))
                self.assertNotIn(0,ans['guesses'])
                if M>=g.r-1:self.assertTrue(ans['success'])
            mask={R:True for R in o.points}
            mask[o.points[2]]=mask[o.points[-2]]=False
            out=ref.mask_reference(self.seal,o,mask,b'\1'*32)
            self.assertEqual(out['support']['exact_small'],2**((g.r-1)//2-2))
            self.assertEqual(out['draw_count'],1023)
            self.assertEqual(out['unique_draws']+out['duplicate_draws'],1023)
            for index in range(out['draw_count']):
                labels=ref.unpack_labels(out,index)
                self.assertEqual(labels[1],0);self.assertEqual(labels[-1],1)
                self.assertIsNone(labels[2]);self.assertIsNone(labels[-2])
                for k in range(1,g.r):
                    if labels[k] is not None:self.assertEqual(labels[k],1-labels[-k])

def authenticate_inputs(out, repo, record, worker_plan, fixture_law=None):
    """Authenticate invocation independently of the worker's matching assertions.

    The explicit fixture seam has no source/VM qualification and is unavailable
    to the ordinary production entry point.
    """
    config=c.read(out/'config.json')
    if fixture_law is not None:
        c.need(fixture_law=='fixed-F11-calibration/v1', 'unknown fixed fixture law')
        c.need(config.get('seed_rules')=={'fixture_only':'fixed00_no_entropy'}, 'fixture invocation declaration')
        c.need(c.read(out/'protocol.json')['protocol_id']=='TEST-F11', 'fixture protocol identity')
        pins={'protocol_sha256':'00'*32, 'source_fingerprint':'00'*32}
        c.need(record['plan']['source_fingerprint']==pins['source_fingerprint'], 'independent fixture source pin')
        c.need(config['inputs']['protocol']['sha256']==pins['protocol_sha256'], 'independent fixture protocol pin')
        inputs={'workload_law':fixture_law,'max_jsonl_line_bytes':record['plan']['limits']['max_jsonl_line_bytes']}
    else:
        expected, invocation, static, _=c.make_plan(repo,config)
        c.need(expected==record['plan'], 'controller plan differs from independent invocation')
        c.need(worker_plan.get('provenance',{}).get('protocol_sha256')==invocation['inputs']['protocol']['sha256'] and worker_plan.get('provenance',{}).get('source_fingerprint')==expected['source_fingerprint'], 'worker provenance differs from independent invocation')
        for role,binding in invocation['inputs'].items():
            copied=out/(role+'.json')
            c.need(c.sha_file(copied)==binding['sha256'], 'copied input hash mismatch: '+role)
            c.need(c.read(copied)==static[role], 'copied input semantics differ: '+role)
        wm,_=c.source_payload(repo,out/'worker_manifest.json','worker')
        hm,hosts=c.source_payload(repo,out/'host_manifest.json','host')
        fingerprint=c.sha_bytes(c.canonical({'worker':wm,'host':hm}))
        c.need(fingerprint==expected['source_fingerprint'], 'copied source fingerprint mismatch')
        # Every module already executing on the host must be in the exact map.
        executing=[Path(__file__),Path(c.__file__),Path(driver.__file__),Path(analysis.__file__),
                   c.safe(repo,c.PREFIX+'/host/verify.py'),c.safe(repo,c.PREFIX+'/host/reference.py'),
                   Path(__file__).with_name('render_report.py')]
        for path in executing:
            relative=path.resolve().relative_to(Path(repo).resolve()).as_posix()
            c.need(relative in hosts and c.sha_file(path)==hm['files'][relative], 'executing host source not bound: '+relative)
        pins={'protocol_sha256':invocation['inputs']['protocol']['sha256'],'source_fingerprint':fingerprint}
        inputs={'workload_law':'production/v1','prior_exclusions':static['prior_exclusions'],
                'max_jsonl_line_bytes':expected['limits']['max_jsonl_line_bytes']}
    for key,value in pins.items():
        c.need(worker_plan.get('provenance',{}).get(key)==value, 'worker provenance differs from invocation: '+key)
    return inputs


def run(out,destination,repo,verifier=None,interface=None,inner_transport=False,fixture_law=None):
    supervisor=Path(out)
    out=supervisor/'modal' if (supervisor/'modal').is_dir() else supervisor
    destination=Path(destination)
    destination.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
    receipt=out/'controller-receipt.json'
    record={'status':'failed','files':[],'engine_execs':0,'plan':{'limits':{'max_jsonl_line_bytes':64<<20}},'controller_record_missing':True}
    export={'schema':c.SCHEMA+'postrun-result/v1','status':'incomplete','observed_only':True,
            'scientific_validity':'not_assessed','wall_valid':False,'counter_replay_qualified':False,
            'automatic_retry':False,'artifacts':[],'errors':[]}
    try:
        driver.check(supervisor,allow_inner=inner_transport)
        record=c.read(receipt)
        c.need(record['status']=='complete','operational failure; no host oracle work allowed')
        evidence=c.custody_for(out/'collected',record)
        plan=c.read(out/'collected/host-plan.json')

        authenticated=authenticate_inputs(out,repo,record,plan,fixture_law)
        public_path=out/'collected/public-cohort.json'
        entry=next((e for e in record['files'] if e['path']=='public-cohort.json'),None)
        c.need(entry is not None and c.sha_file(public_path)==entry['sha256'],'sealed public cohort missing')
        data=public_path.read_bytes()
        c.need(c.sha_bytes(data)==plan['provenance']['cohort_sha256'],'cohort provenance mismatch')
        plan['public_cohort_bytes_hex']=data.hex()
        interface=interface or c.read(out/'engine_interface.json')
        # Host module import is deliberately after custody gate and termination ACK.
        if verifier is None:
            manifest=c.read(out/'host_manifest.json')
            path=c.safe(repo,c.PREFIX+'/host/verify.py')
            c.need(c.sha_file(path)==manifest['files'][c.PREFIX+'/host/verify.py'],'host verifier source mismatch')
            host=c.module(path,'verify')
            verifier=host.verify_bundle
            reference=c.module(c.safe(repo,c.PREFIX+'/host/reference.py'),'reference')

        with (destination/'host-cells.jsonl').open('x') as stream:
            def emit(row):
                stream.write(json.dumps(row,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False)+'\n'); stream.flush()
            checked=verifier(out/'collected/raw',evidence,plan,interface,emit=emit,authenticated_inputs=authenticated)
        c.write(destination/'verification.json',checked)
        if 'host' in locals():
            master=os.urandom(32)
            c.write(destination/'host-seed-event.json',{'master_hex':master.hex(),'bytes':32,'phase':'after_authenticated_frozen_workload_verification_collection_seal_quiescence_termination_ack','model':'domain-separated SHA256 null and uniform streams from one fresh host master'})
            run_references(host,reference,out/'collected/raw',evidence,plan,c.read(public_path),master,destination,record['plan']['limits']['max_jsonl_line_bytes'])
        summary=analysis.summarize(out/'collected/raw',record['plan']['limits']['max_jsonl_line_bytes'])
        c.write(destination/'analysis.json',summary)
        export['status']='complete'
    except Exception as error:
        export['errors'].append({'type':type(error).__name__,'message':str(error)})
        # Available candidate counts retain operational/partial/zero/undefined states.
        raw=out/'collected/raw'
        try:
            summary=analysis.summarize(raw,record['plan']['limits']['max_jsonl_line_bytes'])
            c.write(destination/'partial-analysis.json',summary)
        except Exception as partial:
            export['errors'].append({'partial_analysis':type(partial).__name__,'message':str(partial)})
    for p in sorted(destination.iterdir()):
        if p.is_file(): export['artifacts'].append({'path':p.name,'sha256':c.sha_file(p),'bytes':p.stat().st_size})
    export['raw_transport']={'receipt_sha256':c.sha_file(receipt) if receipt.is_file() else None, 'files':record['files'], 'status':record['status'],
                             'integrity_scope':'inner_transport_only' if inner_transport else 'complete_supervisor_envelope'}
    ep=c.module(Path(repo)/'tools/experiment_protocol.py','_controlled_unified_export')
    try:
        bundle,findings=make_export(ep,out,destination,record,export,supervisor if not inner_transport else None)
        c.write(destination/'export.json',bundle)
        validation={'findings':findings,'schema_compliant':not ep.schema_errors(bundle,'experiment.export/v1'),'protocol_qualified':not findings}
    except (OSError,KeyError,ValueError) as error:
        findings=['unified export unavailable without required protocol/input bytes: '+str(error)]
        validation={'findings':findings,'schema_compliant':False,'protocol_qualified':False}
    c.write(destination/'export.validation.json',validation)
    export['export_findings']=findings
    c.write(destination/'postrun-result.json',export)
    # Export seals raw and analysis only. Reports consume its completed findings;
    # neither report nor export attempts to hash its own bytes.
    renderer=c.module(Path(__file__).with_name('render_report.py'),'_controlled_render')
    renderer.render(destination)
    return export


def run_references(verify,reference,raw,evidence,plan,public,master,destination,max_line):
    """Host-only observed banks; packed masks never expand to 1023*r tables."""
    from collections import Counter,defaultdict
    raw=Path(raw);destination=Path(destination)
    seal=verify.open_sealed(raw,evidence)
    trace_meta={}
    for trace in analysis.rows(raw/'traces.jsonl',max_line):
        trace_meta[trace['trace_id']]={'curve_id':trace['curve_id'],'target':trace['target'],'target_id':trace['target_id']}
        c.need(len(trace_meta)<=36864,'trace metadata resource cap')
    # Bounded byte-offset index; cells remain streamed and retained exactly.
    offsets=defaultdict(list)
    with (raw/'decoder-cells.jsonl').open('rb') as f:
        while True:
            start=f.tell();line=f.readline(max_line+1)
            if not line:break
            c.need(len(line)<=max_line and line.endswith(b'\n'),'cell line resource bound/partial')
            cell=json.loads(line,object_pairs_hook=c.unique,parse_constant=analysis.nonfinite,parse_float=analysis.finite_float)
            curve=trace_meta[cell['trace_id']]['curve_id'];offsets[curve].append((start,len(line)))
            c.need(sum(map(len,offsets.values()))<=73728,'cell offset index resource cap')
    total=sum(curve['model']['r'] for curve in public['curves'])
    c.need(total<=plan.get('max_total_orbit_points',1196032),'total independent orbit resource cap')
    def seed(namespace):return bytes.fromhex(c.sha_bytes(master+namespace.encode()))
    refs=[];calibration=[]
    for curve in public['curves']:
        ident=curve['curve_id'];match=analysis.SLOT.fullmatch(ident)
        stage=match[1] if match else 'disclosed_fixture'
        oracle=verify.Oracle(seal,curve['model'],curve['base'])
        oracle_setup_counts=dict(oracle.group.counts)
        r=curve['model']['r'];bank=[];starts=[];arms=defaultdict(Counter);hist=defaultdict(Counter)
        # All eight retained calibration arms; duplicate draws retained.
        for single in analysis.rows(raw/'single-points.jsonl',max_line):
            if single['curve_id']!=ident:continue
            scalar=oracle.logs[tuple(single['point'])]
            setup_arm=single['arm_id'];a=int(setup_arm.rsplit('.a',1)[1]);s=scalar*pow(a,-1,r)%r
            truth=int(s>r//2);bit=single['answer']['bit'];state='undefined' if bit is None else ('correct' if bit==truth else 'wrong')
            arms[setup_arm][state]+=1;arms[setup_arm]['n']+=1
            arms[setup_arm]['score_sum']+=(0 if bit is None else (1 if bit==truth else -1))
            if setup_arm=='circuit2.a1':bank.append(scalar)
        for trace in analysis.rows(raw/'traces.jsonl',max_line):
            if trace['curve_id']!=ident or trace['incremental'] is not None:continue
            attempt=trace['original'];arm=trace['arm_id']
            if attempt is None:hist[arm]['missing_attempt']+=1;continue
            a=trace['base_multiplier'];errors=erasures=0
            for query in attempt['predicate_trace']:
                scalar=oracle.logs[tuple(query['target'])]*pow(a,-1,r)%r
                bit=query['answer']['bit']
                if bit is None:erasures+=1
                elif bit!=int(scalar>r//2):errors+=1
            hist[arm][str(errors)+','+str(erasures)]+=1
            if arm=='circuit2.a1' and attempt['predicate_trace']:starts.append(oracle.logs[tuple(attempt['predicate_trace'][0]['target'])])
        calibration.append({'curve_id':ident,'stage':stage,'arms':{k:{**dict(v),'correlation':{'numerator':v['score_sum'],'denominator':v['n']}} for k,v in arms.items()},
            'error_erasure_histograms':{k:dict(v) for k,v in hist.items()},
            'score_definition':'+1 defined correct, -1 defined wrong, 0 undefined; unconditioned denominator includes every retained draw',
            'precision_rule':{'m_required':1800,'epsilon':0.1,'K':192,'family_bound':384*math.exp(-1800*0.1**2/2),'assumption':'independent uniform with-replacement draws on fixed curves; not curve-population uncertainty'}})
        target_results=[]
        if stage in ['confirmation-A','confirmation-B'] or stage=='disclosed_fixture':
            bsgs=reference.BSGS(seal,oracle.group,oracle.base)
            for target in curve['targets']:
                target_results.append({'target_id':target['target_id'],'point':target['point'],'bsgs':bsgs.solve(tuple(target['point']))})
        null_path=None
        if stage in ['discovery','validation']:
            mask={point:oracle.evaluate(point,-2,-1,1)['bit'] is not None for point in oracle.points}
            null=reference.mask_reference(seal,oracle,mask,seed('null/'+ident),arm_id='circuit2.a1')
            observed={'score_sum':arms['circuit2.a1']['score_sum'],'q0_successes':hist['circuit2.a1']['0,0']}
            stats=reference.retained_bank_statistics(seal,oracle,null,bank,starts,observed=observed) if null.get('status') in ['complete','degenerate'] else None
            null_path='null-'+ident+'.json'
            c.write(destination/null_path,{'mask_reference':null,'retained_bank_statistics':stats,'bank_n':len(bank),'start_n':len(starts),'descriptive_only':True})
        uniform_path='uniform-'+ident+'.jsonl'
        with (destination/uniform_path).open('x') as target,(raw/'decoder-cells.jsonl').open('rb') as source:
            for offset,length in offsets[ident]:
                source.seek(offset);cell=json.loads(source.read(length),object_pairs_hook=c.unique,parse_constant=analysis.nonfinite,parse_float=analysis.finite_float)
                meta=trace_meta[cell['trace_id']]
                uniform=reference.uniform_list(seal,oracle.group,oracle.base,tuple(meta['target']),cell['M'],seed('uniform/'+cell['cell_id']))
                target.write(json.dumps({'trace_id':cell['trace_id'],'cell_id':cell['cell_id'],'M':cell['M'],'uniform':uniform},sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False)+'\n');target.flush()
        refs.append({'curve_id':ident,'stage':stage,'orbit_points':len(oracle.points),'bsgs_targets':target_results,
            'null_file':null_path,'uniform_file':uniform_path,'independent_oracle_setup_counts':oracle_setup_counts,'independent_host_backend_counts':dict(oracle.group.counts),
            'counter_scope':'host backend separate from worker; no independent worker counter replay; all-r setup and references are host-only paid instrumentation'})
    c.write(destination/'calibration.json',{'curves':calibration,'descriptive_only':True,'null_primary_only':True})
    c.write(destination/'references.json',{'curves':refs,'wall_valid':False,'counter_replay_qualified':False})


def entry(path,base,kind='raw'):
    path=Path(path)
    return {'path':os.path.relpath(path,base),'sha256':c.sha_file(path),'bytes':path.stat().st_size,'kind':kind}


def make_export(ep,out,destination,record,result,supervisor=None):
    protocol=c.read(out/'protocol.json')
    bundle=ep.export_skeleton(protocol,os.path.relpath(out/'protocol.json',destination),'modal',protocol['protocol_id']+'.controlled-export')
    bundle['producer']={'runtime':'codex_cli','model':None,'session':None,'role':'executor'}
    bundle['source']={'repo':protocol['repository'],'commit':record['plan'].get('source_revisions',{}).get('host'),'dirty':None}
    receipt=out/'controller-receipt.json' if (out/'controller-receipt.json').is_file() else out/'controller-error.json'
    bundle['host']['path']=os.path.relpath(receipt,destination) if receipt.is_file() else None
    bundle['host']['sha256']=c.sha_file(receipt) if receipt.is_file() else None
    arm=protocol['extensions']['controlled_followup']['export_arm']
    c.need(arm in {a['id'] for a in protocol['arms']},'composite export arm absent from protocol')
    actual=record.get('engine_execs',0)>0
    if actual:
        summary_path=destination/('analysis.json' if (destination/'analysis.json').exists() else 'partial-analysis.json')
        summary=c.read(summary_path) if summary_path.exists() else {}
        rows=summary.get('per_curve_six_cell',[])
        identity=record.get('supervisor_identity',{})
        c.need(identity.get('experiment_id')==protocol['protocol_id'] and str(identity.get('run_id','')).startswith('RUN-'),'allocated supervisor identity required for export')
        bundle['runs']=[ep.run_row(run_id=identity['run_id'],arm=arm,instance_id='candidate-vm',replicate=0,seed=None,
            status='succeeded' if record['status']=='complete' else 'infra_error',attempts=1,resumed=0,
            measurements={'counted':{'retained_decoder_cells':sum(r['attempts'] for r in rows),'retained_success_events':sum(r['successes'] for r in rows)},
                'counters':{'per_curve_six_cell_json':json.dumps(rows,sort_keys=True),'counter_replay_qualified':'false','unmetered':'native RSS,interpreter allocations,I/O,integer internals'},'wall_valid':False},
            verification={'status':'verified' if result['status']=='complete' else 'error','verifier':'source-bound independent host verify_bundle' if result['status']=='complete' else None},
            exclusion={'excluded':result['status']!='complete','rule':'operationally incomplete or independent verification failed' if result['status']!='complete' else None},worker=record.get('sandbox_id'))]
    bundle['flow']=ep.compute_flow(bundle['runs'])
    # The complete heterogeneous schedule remains data, never padded rows.
    files=[entry(p,destination,'raw') for p in sorted((out/'collected').rglob('*')) if p.is_file()] if (out/'collected').exists() else []
    files.extend(entry(p,destination,'receipt') for p in sorted(out.glob('*.json')))
    outputs=[entry(p,destination,'report' if p.suffix in {'.pdf','.svg','.md'} else 'analysis') for p in sorted(destination.iterdir()) if p.is_file()]
    if supervisor is not None:
        files.extend(entry(supervisor/name,destination,'receipt') for name in ['manifest.yaml','raw-result.json','modal-evidence.tar.gz','modal-evidence-manifest.json'])
    files.extend(outputs);bundle['files']=files
    bundle['analysis']={'script':entry(Path(__file__).with_name('analysis.py'),destination,'analysis'),'outputs':outputs,'blinded':False,'blinding_key_sha256':None,'unmasked_at':None}
    bundle['notes']=[{'kind':'observation','by':'controlled postrun','text':'One actual composite supervisor execution row; raw calibration/confirmation schedules and shared six-cell outcomes retained. No padded observations. Wall clocks and counter replay unqualified; no scientific conclusion.'}]
    bundle['backend_record']=result
    findings=ep.schema_errors(bundle,'experiment.export/v1') or ep.lint_export(bundle,protocol,destination,True)
    return bundle,findings


def main():
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument('--out',type=Path,required=True);p.add_argument('--destination',type=Path,required=True);p.add_argument('--repo-root',type=Path,required=True)
    a=p.parse_args(); result=run(a.out,a.destination,a.repo_root)
    print(json.dumps({'status':result['status'],'errors':result['errors'],'scientific_validity':'not_assessed'}))
    return 0 if result['status']=='complete' and not result.get('export_findings') else 1

class Writer(io.BytesIO):
    def __init__(self,store,name):super().__init__();self.store=store;self.name=name
    def close(self):self.store[self.name]=self.getvalue();super().close()


class Sandbox:
    object_id='sb-MOCK-F11'
    def __init__(self,files):self.files=files;self.stage={};self.events=[];self.fail_terminate=False
    def open(self,name,mode):
        self.events.append(('open',name))
        if mode=='wb':return Writer(self.stage,name)
        return io.BytesIO(b'{}' if name.startswith('/opt/study/') else self.files[name.removeprefix('/work/result/')])
    def exec(self,*argv,**kwargs):
        self.events.append(('exec',argv[0]))
        entries=[{'path':p,'sha256':c.sha_bytes(b),'size':len(b)} for p,b in self.files.items()]
        return type('Proc',(),{'wait':lambda s:0,'stdout':io.StringIO(json.dumps({'engine_returncode':0,'uid1000_quiescent':True,'files':entries})), 'stderr':io.StringIO('')})()
    def terminate(self,wait):
        self.events.append(('terminate',wait))
        if self.fail_terminate:raise RuntimeError('retained termination failure')
        return -15

        good={n:b'import hashlib\n' for n in c.WORKER};c.audit_closure(good)
        for payload in [b'import host.verify\n',b'import reference\n',b'__import__("host")\n']:
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):c.audit_closure({**good,'engine.py':payload})


    def test_strict_static_json_rejects_nonfinite_overflow_and_duplicates(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as root:
            path=Path(root)/'input.json'
            for data in [b'{"x":NaN}',b'{"x":Infinity}',b'{"x":1e999}',b'{"x":0,"x":1}']:
                path.write_bytes(data)
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):c.read(path)

    def test_custody_capability_rejects_duplicate_and_missing_required_entries(self):
        for mutant in ['duplicate','host-plan','public-cohort']:
            with self.subTest(mutant=mutant),tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as root:
                out,record,_=mocked_run(root)
                if mutant=='duplicate':record['files'].append(copy.deepcopy(record['files'][0]))
                else:record['files']=[e for e in record['files'] if e['path']!=mutant+'.json']
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):c.custody_for(out/'collected',record)

        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as root:

            self.assertEqual(driver.check(out,allow_inner=True)['integrity_scope'],'inner_transport_only')

    def test_supervisor_resealed_identity_status_member_and_receipt_mutants(self):
        import shutil
        for mutant in ['manifest-id','raw-id','manifest-status','controller-id','protocol-id','extra-member','missing-member','duplicate-member','duplicate-receipt']:
            with self.subTest(mutant=mutant),tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as root:
                source,record,_=mocked_run(root)
                c.write(Path(root)/'protocol.json',{'protocol_id':'EXP-FIXTURE'})
                out=Path(root)/'supervisor';out.mkdir()
                def completed(repo,cfg,dest,sdk=None,supervisor_identity=None):
                    record['supervisor_identity']=supervisor_identity
                    shutil.copytree(source,dest)
                    for name,value in [('protocol.json',{'protocol_id':'EXP-FIXTURE'}),('controller-receipt.json',record)]:
                        (dest/name).unlink();c.write(dest/name,value)
                    return record
                with patch.object(c,'run',side_effect=completed):
                    driver.run(root,{'inputs':{'protocol':{'path':'protocol.json'}}},out,experiment_id='EXP-FIXTURE',run_id='RUN-FIXTURE')
                self.assertEqual(driver.check(out)['run_id'],'RUN-FIXTURE')
                raw=c.read(out/'raw-result.json');manifest=c.read(out/'manifest.yaml')
                if mutant=='manifest-id':manifest['run']['id']='RUN-WRONG'
                if mutant=='raw-id':raw['run_id']='RUN-OTHER'
                if mutant=='manifest-status':manifest['run']['status']='failed'
                if mutant=='controller-id':raw['controller']['supervisor_identity']['run_id']='RUN-OTHER'
                if mutant=='protocol-id':
                    (out/'modal/protocol.json').unlink();c.write(out/'modal/protocol.json',{'protocol_id':'EXP-OTHER'})
                if mutant=='extra-member':c.write(out/'modal/unbound.json',{'extra':True})
                if mutant=='missing-member':(out/'modal/controller-receipt.json').unlink()
                if mutant=='duplicate-receipt':raw['controller']['engine_execs']=99
                if mutant=='duplicate-member':
                    member=c.read(out/'modal-evidence-manifest.json');member['files'].append(copy.deepcopy(member['files'][0]))
                    (out/'modal-evidence-manifest.json').unlink();c.write(out/'modal-evidence-manifest.json',member)
                    raw['evidence']['member_manifest_sha256']=c.sha_file(out/'modal-evidence-manifest.json')
                for name,value in [('manifest.yaml',manifest),('raw-result.json',raw)]:
                    (out/name).unlink();c.write(out/name,value)
                with self.assertRaises((ValueError,FileNotFoundError)):driver.check(out)

        good={n:b'import hashlib\n' for n in c.WORKER}

        c.audit_closure({**good,'engine.py':b'import importlib as loader\nh=loader.import_module("host.verify")\n'})
